availability: A bar is available only when open_time + 8h <= decision_time. Future rows are ignored. Each admitted symbol requires one exact contiguous 253-price suffix on the selected common grid.
transforms: timestamp-wise median return across currently eligible valid native-crypto symbols
conditional OLS slope through the origin on positive common-return observations
conditional OLS slope through the origin on negative common-return observations
centered average ranks for each conditional slope
a5_boundary: The complete final finite built-in dict[str,float] crosses strategy.score_boundary once. Returned values determine span and selection; raw conditional betas are used only for the preregistered post-selection role-separation gate.
execution_owner: The organizer owns orders, fills, costs, funding cashflows, risk state, membership exits, and next-open execution.
